title: Geometric gluing of local universal thickening charts
statement: Let h : Z → X be a morphism of schemes, C an open cover of Z indexed in the schemes universe, and for every k let i_k : C_k → Z′_k and h′_k : Z′_k → X be a universal first order thickening of C_k over X for C.f_k ≫ h [def-weil-pbc-universal-first-order-thickening]. There exist W, j : Z → W, p : W → X and an open cover D of W in the same universe such that j is a first order thickening [def-sbc-first-order-thickening], j ≫ p = h, and for every k the pullback of j along D.f_k is universal over X for the induced source morphism. No formal unramifiedness hypothesis and no global universal lifting property is asserted.

source.place: Tag 04F3 (lemma-universal-thickening), proof, fourth and fifth paragraphs; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04F3

proof.text: Apply the cartesian-atlas construction to obtain W, j, p and jointly covering open immersions e_k, with j followed by p equals h, e_k followed by p equals h_k prime and each local square cartesian. Construct the open cover D with index C.I0, charts Z_k prime and maps e_k.

The cartesian square gives an isomorphism from C_k to the chosen pullback of j and e_k. Its inverse composed with the two original projections is exactly D.pullbackHom j k and (D.pullback1 j).f k. Precomposition by this isomorphism preserves closed immersion and the kernel ideal, hence first order thickening. For universality, compose a test map with the source isomorphism, apply H_k, and use associativity to obtain both equations and uniqueness for the transported lift. This proves universality on each pullback chart.

Closed immersion is local on the target, so j is closed from the pullback-chart thickenings. Cover W by the images of all affine opens of all D charts. For each such affine open V, the cartesian kernel comparison identifies the local kernel with the comap of the global kernel on the image of V under the isomorphism on sections. The local kernel squared is zero. Map this equality back through the surjective section isomorphism: Ideal.map_pow and map_comap_of_surjective give zero for the global kernel squared on the image of V. IdealSheafData.ext_of_iSup_eq_top then gives j.ker squared equals bottom globally. Combine this first order assertion with the factorization and transported local universal properties.

lean.statement:
theorem universalFirstOrderThickening_gluedAtlas
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X) (C : Z.OpenCover.{u})
    (Z' : C.I₀ → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ k, C.X k ⟶ Z' k)
    (h' : ∀ k, Z' k ⟶ X)
    (H : ∀ k, IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening (C.f k ≫ h) (i k) (h' k)) :
    ∃ (W : Scheme.{u}) (j : Z ⟶ W) (p : W ⟶ X) (D : W.OpenCover.{u}),
      IsFirstOrderThickening j ∧ j ≫ p = h ∧
        ∀ k, IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening ((D.pullback₁ j).f k ≫ h)
          (D.pullbackHom j k) (D.f k ≫ p)
